title: 第二十三章 山间偶遇第二十四章 一块玉璧
lines: 二月二，龙抬头。
跟熊二对战了十几日，王贤的身上不知留下多少伤痕。
便是老道士时不时配制灵药，让王贤淬体，脸上依旧有一道伤疤没有愈合。
眼见山上的杏花开了，师姐东凰漱玉还没回来。
北坡的师叔却捎来消息，要王贤前往昆仑剑宗，观摩春招大比。
熊二要跟着一起前往，却被老道士出声阻止了。
跟他交代道：“等你师姐回山，商量一下，要不让她带你往东海走上一回......”
熊二一听老道士惦记着自己化形的大事，也不嚷嚷要跟王贤去昆仑剑宗凑热闹了。
说什么呢，他修炼了这么些年，天天盼着化形。
至少也跟老大一起去逛街，哪怕跟在东凰玉身后，拎包也行。
踏着一山春风。
王贤手里捏着一朵野花，时不时跟在受惊的野兔后面，嗷嗷追上一程。
第一次离开道观的王贤，显然有些忐忑，更多的是高兴。
南坡的剑宗怎么说还有师叔东方霓裳，还有一个师姐澹台小雪。
最重要的是，师父交代了，要把师叔欠了好些年的灵石带回去，这才是他前往剑宗的目的。
走在弯弯曲曲的小路上，望着远处阳光下隐隐约约的宫殿飞檐。
王贤心道剑宗果然比师父的道观显得气派，想必师叔也不会赖着灵石不给了。
就在他抬头望向远处剑宗的一瞬间。
山涧上响起一个女子的声音：“小家伙，你要去哪里？”
王贤寻着声音望去，却是一棵雪松树下，搁着一块青板。
边上还有两个石凳，凳子上坐着一个白衣女子。
一个跟南宫芷兰有几分相似，眼眸含烟的女子正跟他招手。
“我要去前面的剑宗！”
王贤飞身上前，问道：“前辈也是跟我一样，去剑宗观摩春试大比吗？”
“不是。”
白衣女子轻抚秀发，取了一个玉杯搁在桌上，拎起面前的玉壶往里缓缓倒入半杯灵酒。
浅浅一笑：“我只是来山间踏青，相请不如偶遇，请尝尝我的灵酒。”
王贤上前端起杯玉放在唇前嗅了一下，又轻轻放下。
笑道：“我还要赶路，要在天黑之前赶到剑宗呢。”
白衣女子摇摇头：“人生苦短......风景只在路上，你又何必急着往终点而去？”
“我这用雪山之巅的雪莲所酿，花了整整十年，可不是随便一个路人，就能品尝的哦。”
“十年？这也太久了吧，那么，谢谢前辈。”
王贤也听师父说过雪山之巅的雪莲，用雪莲酿的灵酒，还花了十年时间，他也想试试。
content_en:
On February 2, the dragon raises its head.
After fighting Xiong Er for more than ten days, Wang Xian's body was left with countless scars.
Even though the old Taoist priest prepared elixirs from time to time to temper Wang Xian's body, there was still a scar on his face that had not healed.
Seeing the apricot blossoms on the mountain blooming, senior sister Donghuang Shuyu has not returned yet.
However, Beipo's uncle sent a message asking Wang Xian to go to the Kunlun Sword Sect to observe the spring recruitment competition.
Xiong Er wanted to go with him, but the old Taoist priest stopped him.
He told him: "When your senior sister comes back to the mountain, we can discuss whether we can let her take you to the East China Sea..."
When Xiong Eryi heard that the old Taoist priest was thinking about his transformation, he stopped clamoring to go to the Kunlun Sword Sect with Wang Xian to join in the fun.
What can I say? He has been practicing for so many years and looks forward to transforming every day.
At least go shopping with the boss, even if you are following Donghuangyu and carrying bags.
Riding on the spring breeze.
Wang Xian held a wild flower in his hand and followed the frightened hare from time to time, wailing to catch up.
Wang Xian, who left the Taoist temple for the first time, was obviously a little worried, but more happy.
The Sword Sect of Nanpo also has an uncle, Dongfang Nishang, and a senior sister, Tantai Xiaoxue.
The most important thing is that the master told him to bring back the spiritual stones that his uncle had owed for many years. This was the purpose of his trip to Sword Sect.
Walking on the winding path, I looked at the faintly visible palace cornices in the distance in the sun.
Wang Xianxin Taoist Sword Sect is indeed more impressive than the master's Taoist temple, so I guess the master uncle will not rely on the spiritual stone.
The moment he raised his head and looked at Jian Zong in the distance.
A woman's voice sounded from the mountain stream: "Little guy, where are you going?"
Wang Xian looked for the sound and saw a blue board under a cedar tree.
There are two stone benches on the side, and a woman in white is sitting on the bench.
A woman who looked somewhat similar to Nangong Zhilan, with smokey eyes, was waving to him.
"I want to go to the Sword Sect in front!"
Wang Xianfei stepped forward and asked: "Senior, are you going to the Sword Sect to observe the Spring Trial Competition like me?"
"No."
The woman in white caressed her hair, took a jade cup and placed it on the table. She picked up the jade pot in front of her and slowly poured half a cup of spiritual wine into it.
Smiling lightly: "I'm just here for an outing in the mountains. It's better to meet by chance than to invite me. Please have a taste of my spiritual wine."
"Ah..."
Wang Xian stepped forward and put the cup of jade in front of his lips, smelled it, and then gently put it down.
He smiled and said, "I still have to hurry and get to Jianzong before dark."
The woman in white shook her head: "Life is short... The scenery is only on the road, so why are you rushing to the destination?"
"I brewed it with snow lotus from the top of the snow-capped mountains. It took me ten years to make it. It's not just something that just a passerby can taste."
"Ten years? This is too long, right? So, thank you, senior."
Wang Xian also heard from his master that it took ten years to brew the spiritual wine from the snow lotus on the top of the snow mountain, and he wanted to try it too.
title_en: Chapter 23: An encounter in the mountains Chapter 24: A piece of jade
